batches.prompt: A fair die is rolled. Find P(number greater than 4).
A bag has 4 red and 2 blue balls. Without replacement, find P(two red).
For that bag, find P(two blue).
For that bag, find P(at least one red in two draws).
Two fair coins are tossed. Find P(exactly one head).
Explain the difference between “at least one head” and “exactly one head” for two tosses.

help: Ask for help whenever stuck. Record any hints; do not count assisted answers as independent.
